name: libc++abi
description: LLVM's implementation of low-level support for a standard C++ ABI, built as a standalone component against the already-installed LLVM/Clang 21.1.8.
build: cmake -G Ninja -S llvm-project-21.1.8.src/runtimes -B llvm-project-21.1.8.src/runtimes/build -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release -D CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX="$PREFIX" -D LLVM_ENABLE_RUNTIMES=libcxxabi -D LLVM_DIR="$PREFIX/lib/cmake/llvm"
